## Summary

Describe the user-facing or maintenance change.

## Safety impact

- [ ] No safety-sensitive behavior changed.
- [ ] Safety-sensitive behavior changed and is described below.

If safety-sensitive, identify affected screens, source data, failure behavior, and tests.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Browser/runtime verification performed, or explicitly noted as not performed.

## Sources
